changelog:
- Security: Removed 4 self-signed/MITM certificate nodes from all routing lists (US New York, GB Slough, CA Toronto, SG). These nodes were intercepting TLS traffic and triggering browser safety warnings.
- Bug Fix: Fixed Fokk Mesh failing to stay connected when entire-device mode is off. The VPN service was incorrectly being stopped on each browser-only connection attempt, tearing down the proxy tunnel.
- Nodes: All remaining nodes verified with valid TLS certificates and no MITM interception. Ingress relay pool cleaned to 4 trusted nodes only.
